claim: Observed mobility volumes and geographic coverage in international and domestic mobility, with comparable country-specific expansion trajectories.
selected_country_rule: The same five country examples retained from the previous Fig2, in the same order

panels.a: Complete international event totals: five separately labelled destination countries plus all other countries; million events
panels.b: Complete domestic intercity event totals: the same five countries plus all other countries; million events; x axis starts at 1998
panels.c: Four-year nested bubbles, area proportional to incoming source-country count; 76 countries
panels.d: Four-year nested bubbles, area proportional to domestic inflow-city count; same 76 countries
panels.e-i: Two solid raw-count series per country: the union of international source/destination countries on the left and domestic origin/destination cities on the right; country-specific axis ranges

event_volume_unit: Million events in both a and b; complete totals including an Others layer

palette.country_palette: Lake blue, pale cyan-blue, apricot, light sand and sage; Others in light grey

bubble_encoding: Circle radius equals the square root of the plotted count; equal-sized axes share an identical coordinate extent, giving both bubble panels the same area per count
bubble_label_rule: Use ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes for every labelled country; all text fits its outer country circle with a 0.65-pt margin and a 5.2-pt font floor; all labels remain editable text

bubble_size_legends.placement: One vertical ticked straight ruler in the upper-right of each bubble panel; no reference circles
bubble_size_legends.scale: Distance from zero to each tick equals the actual plotted bubble diameter: 2*sqrt(count) times the physical data scale

connectors: Ten colour-matched country-identification leaders, five from each bubble panel; not migration edges or causal arrows

bottom_axes.left: Union of international source and destination countries
bottom_axes.right: Union of domestic origin and destination cities
bottom_axes.colour_rule: Blue countries on the left; red cities on the right
bottom_axes.line_rule: Two solid lines, combining inflow and outflow
bottom_axes.axis_colour: Black spines, tick marks, tick labels and y-axis titles on both sides
bottom_axes.quantity_definition: Distinct countries/cities with positive inflow OR outflow in the year; union, not the sum of directional counts

legend_placement.a_b: No separate country legend; five ISO2 codes label 2025 layer ends with short elbow leaders and parallel horizontal terminal segments; Others is written inside its residual band
legend_placement.a_b_insets: Vertical four-year legends inside the upper-right of each inset; complete observed curves end at 64% of the logarithmic x span, reserving internal right-hand white space
legend_placement.c_d: Vertical four-year legend in each bubble panel upper-left
legend_placement.bottom: Two entries: countries (inflow or outflow) in blue; cities (inflow or outflow) in red; both solid

comparison_data_provenance.event_count_unit: One observed mobility event counted once
comparison_data_provenance.international_direction: Inflow to each selected country from all other countries
comparison_data_provenance.domestic_direction: All intercity mobility events within each selected country; destination margins counted once
comparison_data_provenance.stack_scope: Five separately labelled countries plus all remaining countries combined in Other countries
comparison_data_provenance.other_country_rule: Complete annual total minus the sum of the five separately labelled countries
comparison_data_provenance.displayed_unit: Million events in both a and b
comparison_data_provenance.incoming_partner_count: Distinct source countries with positive annual flow
comparison_data_provenance.outgoing_partner_count: Distinct destination countries with positive annual flow
comparison_data_provenance.domestic_city_directions: Positive-flow destination cities for inflow; positive-flow origin cities for outflow
comparison_data_provenance.combined_country_count: Union of source and destination countries, deduplicated per country-year
comparison_data_provenance.combined_domestic_city_count: Union of domestic origin and destination stable city IDs per country-year

inset_partner_data_provenance.directed_edges: Positive-flow distinct year, origin city, destination city across all fields; same-city edges excluded after geographic harmonization
inset_partner_data_provenance.domestic_weighting: Within-country city fractions averaged with equal country weights
inset_partner_data_provenance.reconciliation: All selected-year event totals, geographic node counts and edge counts exactly match existing plotted source tables

cleaned_data_provenance.city_identifier: Cleaned stable origin/destination IDs; no new concatenation with region or city names
cleaned_data_provenance.event_scope: Confirmed international and domestic intercity events; within-city and unresolved records excluded
cleaned_data_provenance.sample_rule: From the complete cleaned data, require at least two domestic origin cities and two destination cities in every year 1998–2025

uncertainty: Descriptive observed counts; no fitted trend or confidence interval
data_boundary: Confirmed events from the 20261020 cleaned data; stable city IDs; within-city and unresolved records excluded

formatting.instruction: Insert at 180 mm without further reduction; manuscript and journal files have independent native typography.
